purpose: Define correlation/conversation/request trace identities that group related evidence without claiming causal ordering.

topics.name: Correlation Identity
topics.purpose: Define correlation/conversation/request trace identities that group related evidence without claiming causal ordering.

semantics.identity_rule: Each correlation scope has explicit identity/profile.
semantics.member_rule: Events/requests/executions/results may reference exact correlation identity.
semantics.causal_rule: Shared correlation never by itself proves causality.
semantics.nested_rule: Parent/child correlations are explicit if supported.
semantics.privacy_rule: Correlation identifiers do not expose protected identity data unnecessarily.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: correlation id used as user identity
